blockers.label: Data lineage
blockers.title: Security questionnaire §2 (data handling) asks for per-record provenance — lineage records not yet provided
blockers.mitigation: Provide the lineage log format and a sample export.

blockers.label: Security questionnaire §7 · Review path
blockers.title: Security questionnaire §7 — review materials and counterparty acceptance of the pilot review path
blockers.mitigation: Provide the security review materials (m9) and have the responsible reviewer confirm the counterparty's written acceptance for this pilot scope (f5). A submitted questionnaire or a completed negotiation task alone does not clear this item.

blockers.label: Consent and authorizations
blockers.title: License draft §9.2 asks you to warrant that 'all necessary consents and authorizations have been obtained' — cannot be warranted while operator biometric consent (m4) and bystander policy (m5) are missing
blockers.mitigation: Escalate consent drafting to counsel (see escalation record); until then, carve consent scope out of the warranty.

blockers.label: Training and sublicensing terms
blockers.title: License draft leaves training rights and sublicensing undefined — the lab's legal team will mark this up, and it is your only pricing lever
blockers.mitigation: Table your own definition before the lab sends its template.

blockers.label: License draft §9.4 · IP assignment
blockers.title: License draft §9.4 — operator agreement evidence and confirmation of IP assignment
blockers.mitigation: Provide operator agreements and any signed IP-assignment addenda (m2), then confirm coverage for every operator against the signature log (f1). Both are required to clear this item; document availability alone does not establish IP assignment.

blockers.label: Age-screening evidence
blockers.title: License draft §9.5 asks you to warrant 'no minors appear in the data' — nobody on the team can confirm it
blockers.mitigation: Stand up an age-screening step and sample the first batch.

blockers.label: Retention and deletion schedule
blockers.title: The lab's DPA template §4 requires a written retention & deletion schedule — the data-business privacy policy (m6) is not provided
blockers.mitigation: Draft the data-business retention schedule; the consumer-site policy does not cover it.
